en.s: The Battle of Falconaria (also La Falconara or Falconeria) was fought in the latter days of the War of the Sicilian Vespers. Fought on 1 December 1299 between the forces of Frederick II of Sicily and Philip I of Taranto of the Kingdom of Naples, it was a momentous victory for Frederick and a disaster for Philip, who was captured.

zh.s: 法尔科纳里亚之战也称拉法尔科纳拉之战，是西西里晚祷战争后期的一场战役。1299年12月1日，西西里国王腓特烈二世的军队与那不勒斯王国塔兰托亲王菲利普一世的军队交战。腓特烈获胜，菲利普被俘。

en.t: Henry V of England enters Paris alongside his father-in-law King Charles VI of France
en.s: Henry V (16 September 1386 – 31 August 1422), also called Henry of Monmouth, was King of England, Lord of Ireland, and Duke of Aquitaine from 1413 until his death in 1422. His victory at Agincourt in 1415 and his conquest of Normandy gave England the upper hand in the Hundred Years' War and led, by the Treaty of Troyes in 1420, to his recognition as heir and regent of France.

zh.t: 英王亨利五世与岳父法王查理六世一同进入巴黎
zh.s: 亨利五世（1386年9月16日—1422年8月31日），又称蒙茅斯的亨利，1413年至1422年去世前一直担任英格兰国王、爱尔兰领主和阿基坦公爵。他于1415年在阿金库尔获胜并征服诺曼底，使英格兰在百年战争中占据上风；根据1420年的《特鲁瓦条约》，他获承认为法国王位继承人和摄政王。

en.s: The Massacre of Naarden was an episode of mass murder and looting that took place in the Dutch city of Naarden on 1 December 1572, during the Eighty Years' War. The massacre was committed by Spanish soldiers under the command of Fadrique Álvarez de Toledo against the townspeople of Naarden as part of a punitive expedition against Dutch rebels later known as the Spanish Fury.

zh.s: 1572年12月1日，八十年战争期间，西班牙军队在法德里克·阿尔瓦雷斯·德·托莱多指挥下，对荷兰纳尔登市民实施大屠杀并劫掠城镇。这是针对荷兰叛军的一次惩罚性远征，后来被称为“西班牙暴行”。

en.t: The Portuguese Restoration War, which began with a coup d'état organised by the nobility and bourgeoisie in Lisbon and executed on 1 December 1640, restored Portuguese independence
en.s: Lisbon ( LIZ-bən; Portuguese: Lisboa [liʒˈβoɐ] ) is the capital and most populous city of Portugal, with an estimated population of 658,236 as of 2025, within its administrative limits and 3,353,000 within the metropolis, as of 2025. The city lies on the Atlantic Ocean in the western part of the Iberian Peninsula, fronting the northern shore of the River Tagus.

zh.t: 葡萄牙复国战争爆发，贵族和资产阶级于1640年12月1日在里斯本发动政变，恢复葡萄牙独立
zh.s: 里斯本（葡萄牙语：Lisboa）是葡萄牙首都，也是人口最多的城市。截至2025年，其市界内估计人口为658,236，大都市区人口为3,353,000。里斯本位于伊比利亚半岛西部、面向大西洋，坐落在塔霍河北岸。

en.t: End of the Iberian Union: Portugal acclaims as King João IV of Portugal, ending 59 years of personal union of the crowns of Portugal and Spain and the end of the rule of the Philippine Dynasty
en.s: The Iberian Union, or the Hispanic Monarchy, describes the period from 1580 to 1640 in which the Monarchy of Spain under the Habsburg dynasty, then the personal union of the crowns of Castile and Aragon, brought in personal union also the Kingdom of Portugal. It incorporated the entire Iberian Peninsula, except Andorra and French territory, as well as Portuguese and Spanish overseas possessions, under the Spanish Habsburg monarchs Philip II, Philip III, and Philip IV.

zh.t: 伊比利亚联盟终结：葡萄牙拥立若昂四世为王，结束葡萄牙与西班牙王冠59年的共主联合及哈布斯堡王朝统治
zh.s: 伊比利亚联盟又称西班牙君主联合，指1580年至1640年间，哈布斯堡王朝统治下的西班牙君主国（当时卡斯蒂利亚和阿拉贡王冠处于共主联合）与葡萄牙王国也组成共主联合的时期。除安道尔和法国领土外，它将整个伊比利亚半岛以及葡萄牙和西班牙的海外领地纳入西班牙哈布斯堡君主腓力二世、腓力三世和腓力四世的统治之下。

en.s: The battle of Piercebridge was fought on 1 December 1642 in County Durham, England, during the First English Civil War. The Earl of Newcastle was advancing with an army of 6,000 from Newcastle upon Tyne to York to reinforce the local Royalists. Aware of his approach, the Parliamentarians defended the main crossing over the River Tees, at Piercebridge.

zh.s: 1642年12月1日，第一次英国内战期间，英国达勒姆郡发生皮尔斯布里奇之战。纽卡斯尔伯爵率领6000人的军队，从泰恩河畔纽卡斯尔向约克进军，增援当地保王党。议会派得知其行军后，守住泰斯河上的主要渡口皮尔斯布里奇。

en.s: The Storming of Farnham Castle occurred on 1 December 1642, during the early stages of the First English Civil War, when a Parliamentarian force attacked the Royalist garrison at Farnham Castle in Surrey. Sir John Denham had taken possession of the castle for the Royalists in mid-November, but after the Royalists had been turned back from London at the Battle of Turnham Green, a Parliamentarian force under the command of Sir William Waller approached the castle.

zh.s: 1642年12月1日，第一次英国内战初期，议会派军队进攻萨里郡法纳姆城堡的保王派驻军。约翰·丹纳姆爵士于11月中旬为保王派占领城堡；保王派在特纳姆格林战役中被击退、未能进入伦敦后，威廉·沃勒爵士率领的议会派军队向城堡进发。

en.s: The Battle of Hieton was fought on the 1 December 1650 between a force of Scottish Remonstrants under Colonel Gilbert Ker and 1,000 English commanded by Major-general John Lambert. The site of the battle was by the Cadzow Burn, near the present day town centre of Hamilton, Scotland. The Scots attacked, surprising the English, but were beaten back and destroyed as a fighting force.

zh.s: 1650年12月1日，吉尔伯特·克尔上校率领的苏格兰抗议派军队与约翰·兰伯特少将指挥的1000名英军在海顿交战。战场位于苏格兰汉密尔顿镇中心附近的卡德佐溪。苏格兰军突袭了英军，但被击退，丧失了继续作战的能力。

en.t: John Evelyn records skating in St James’s Park
en.s: On December 1, 1662, diarist John Evelyn watched people skate on the frozen canal in London’s St James’s Park. He described their speed and sudden stops as they performed before the king and queen. Evelyn recorded seeing the skaters; his diary does not say he skated himself.
en.n: Evelyn's dated diary entry describes what he witnessed, not his own skating.

zh.t: 约翰·伊夫林在日记中记下圣詹姆斯公园的滑冰场景
zh.s: 1662年12月1日，英国日记作家约翰·伊夫林在伦敦圣詹姆斯公园，看见人们在结冰的水道上滑冰。他写下滑冰者在国王和王后面前疾行、急停的场面。日记说的是他观看滑冰，并没有说他自己上了冰。
zh.n: 日记记载的是伊夫林当天看到的情景，不是他本人滑冰。

en.t: The slave ship Fredensborg sinks off Tromøya in Norway
en.s: Fredensborg was a frigate built in Copenhagen in 1753. She was originally named Cron Prindz Christian after the crown prince, the future king Christian VII of Denmark and Norway, and was fitted out as a slave ship.

zh.t: 贩奴船“弗雷登斯堡号”在挪威特罗姆岛附近沉没
zh.s: “弗雷登斯堡号”是一艘1753年在哥本哈根建造的护卫舰。它最初以王储、后来的丹麦和挪威国王克里斯蒂安七世之名命名为“克朗·普林茨·克里斯蒂安号”，后来改装为贩奴船。

en.s: The 1792 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on December 1, 1792, in order to elect the Governor of Connecticut. Incumbent Federalist Governor of Connecticut Samuel Huntington won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1792年12月1日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。现任联邦党州长塞缪尔·亨廷顿没有对手，成功连任。

en.s: At the Battle of Ampfing on 1 December 1800, Paul Grenier's two divisions of the First French Republic opposed against the Austrian army southwest of the town of Ampfing during the French Revolutionary Wars. The Austrians, under the leadership of Archduke John of Austria, forced their enemies to retreat, though they sustained greater losses than the French. Ampfing is located 63 kilometers (39 miles) east of Munich and 8 km (5.0 mi) west of Mühldorf am Inn. In Spring 1800, while Moreau wrecked Austrian defenses in Germany, Generals Massena and Desaix ran into stiff Austrian offensives in Northern Italy.

zh.s: 1800年12月1日，法国大革命战争期间，保罗·格雷尼耶率领法兰西第一共和国军队两个师，在安普芬镇西南与奥地利军交战。奥地利军由约翰大公指挥，迫使法军撤退，但自身伤亡超过法军。安普芬位于慕尼黑以东63公里、米尔多夫以西8公里。1800年春，莫罗在德国重创奥地利防线之际，马塞纳和德赛在意大利北部遭遇奥地利军的强力攻势。

en.t: 1800 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania
en.s: A presidential election was held in Pennsylvania on December 1, 1800, as part of the 1800 United States presidential election. Members of the Pennsylvania General Assembly chose 15 electors to represent Pennsylvania in the Electoral College. Eight Democratic-Republican electors and seven Federalist electors were selected.

zh.t: 1800年美国总统选举宾夕法尼亚州投票
zh.s: 作为1800年美国总统选举的一部分，宾夕法尼亚州于1800年12月1日举行总统选举投票。州议会选出15名选举人代表宾夕法尼亚参加选举人团投票，其中民主共和党选举人8名，联邦党选举人7名。

Democratic-Republican candidate and former Adjutant General of North Carolina Benjamin Smith was elected by the North Carolina General Assembly against incumbent Democratic-Republican governor David Stone.

zh.s: 1810年12月1日，北卡罗来纳州举行州长选举。民主共和党候选人、前州副官长本杰明·史密斯由州议会选出，击败了时任民主共和党州长戴维·斯通。

en.s: The First Battle of Ibarra occurred in the vicinity of the city of Ibarra, Ecuador, between 27 November and 1 December 1812. The event, which is part of the Spanish American Wars of Independence, pitted the troops of the State of Quito against those of the Spanish Empire.

en.t: Pedro I is crowned Emperor of Brazil
en.s: Dom Pedro I (12 October 1798 – 24 September 1834), known in Brazil and in Portugal as "the Liberator" (Portuguese: o Libertador) or "the Soldier King" (o Rei Soldado) in Portugal, was the founder and first ruler of the Empire of Brazil from 1822 to 1831 (under the name of Pedro I) and King of Portugal in 1826 (under the name of Pedro IV).

zh.t: 佩德罗一世加冕为巴西皇帝
zh.s: 佩德罗一世（1798年10月12日—1834年9月24日）在巴西和葡萄牙被称为“解放者”，在葡萄牙还被称为“军人国王”。他是巴西帝国的建立者和首位统治者，1822年至1831年以佩德罗一世之名在位；1826年又以佩德罗四世之名担任葡萄牙国王。

en.s: The 1823 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on December 1, 1823, in order to elect the governor of North Carolina. en.t: Electors cast presidential ballots in the 1824 United States election
en.s: On December 1, 1824, presidential electors met in their states and cast their ballots. Maryland's record shows its 11 votes split among Andrew Jackson, John Quincy Adams and William H. Crawford. When Congress formally counted the nationwide electoral votes on February 9, 1825, no presidential candidate had a majority. The House then chose Adams under the Twelfth Amendment.
en.n: Electors voted on December 1, 1824; Congress counted the national vote and the House chose a president on February 9, 1825.

zh.t: 1824年美国总统选举：选举人投票
zh.s: 1824年12月1日，美国各州的总统选举人投票。马里兰州的11张选举人票分别投给安德鲁·杰克逊、约翰·昆西·亚当斯和威廉·克劳福德。国会到1825年2月9日才正式清点全国选举人票；由于无人获得过半数，众议院依照宪法第十二修正案选出亚当斯。
zh.n: 选举人于1824年12月1日投票；国会清点票数和众议院选出总统是在1825年2月9日。

en.s: The Decembrist revolution (Spanish: Revolución decembrina) was a military coup in the Buenos Aires Province, Argentina. Juan Lavalle, returning with the troops that fought in the Argentine-Brazilian War, made a coup on December 1, 1828, deposed the governor Manuel Dorrego and closed the legislature. Dorrego was captured and executed a short time afterwards. The rancher Juan Manuel de Rosas organized militias that fought against Lavalle and removed him from power, restoring the legislature. However, as the coup had reignited the Argentine Civil Wars, Rosas was appointed governor of the Buenos Aires province to wage the war against the Unitarian League.

zh.s: 1828年12月1日，参加阿根廷—巴西战争的部队返回后，胡安·拉瓦列在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯省发动军事政变，推翻省长曼努埃尔·多雷戈并解散议会。多雷戈被捕后不久遭处决。庄园主胡安·曼努埃尔·德·罗萨斯组织民兵与拉瓦列交战，最终将其赶下台并恢复议会。政变重新点燃阿根廷内战后，罗萨斯被任命为布宜诺斯艾利斯省省长，负责对抗统一派联盟。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: A presidential election was held in South Carolina on December 1, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. The state legislature chose 9 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. South Carolina cast 9 electoral votes for the Democratic candidate James K. Polk. These electors were chosen by the South Carolina General Assembly, the state legislature, rather than by popular vote.

zh.t: 1844年美国总统选举南卡罗来纳州投票
zh.s: 作为1844年美国总统选举的一部分，南卡罗来纳州于1844年12月1日举行投票。州议会选出9名选举人投票选出总统和副总统。南卡罗来纳州的9张选举人票均投给民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克。选举人由州议会选出，而非由普选产生。

en.s: The Battle of Başgedikler occurred on 1 December 1853 during the Crimean War when a Russian army attacked and defeated a large Turkish force near the village of Başgedikler in the Trans-Caucasus.

zh.s: 1853年12月1日，克里米亚战争期间，俄军在外高加索地区巴什盖迪克莱尔村附近进攻并击败一支规模庞大的土耳其军队。

en.s: An election for Mayor of New York City was held on December 1, 1857. Fernando Wood ran for re-election to a third term in office. His second term in office had marked by conflict with the Republican state legislature and the leadership of Tammany Hall. As a result, the state legislature voted to revise the city charter to shorten his current term to one year and hold an election for a new two-year term.

zh.s: 1857年12月1日举行纽约市长选举，费尔南多·伍德竞选连任，争取第三个任期。他的第二个任期与共和党控制的州议会及坦慕尼协会领导层发生冲突。为此，州议会投票修改市宪章，将他当前任期缩短为一年，并举行选举选出新任两年期市长。

en.t: Lincoln sends his second annual message to Congress calling for an end to slavery
en.s: On December 1, 1862, President Abraham Lincoln sent his second annual message to Congress. He urged the Union to pursue the abolition of slavery and proposed a gradual, compensated emancipation plan. In keeping with the practice of the time, the Secretary of the Senate read the message aloud. The message was separate from Lincoln's September preliminary Emancipation Proclamation.
en.n: Date of the annual message to Congress; Lincoln did not personally deliver it as a speech.

zh.t: 林肯向国会提交第二份年度咨文，呼吁终结奴隶制
zh.s: 1862年12月1日，美国总统林肯向国会提交第二份年度咨文，呼吁联邦结束奴隶制，并提出逐步解放奴隶、向奴隶主给予补偿的方案。按当时的惯例，咨文由参议院秘书代为宣读。这份咨文与林肯同年9月发布的《解放奴隶宣言》预告是两份不同文件。
zh.n: 记录咨文提交国会的日期；林肯并未亲自到场演讲。

en.t: Shaw University, the first historically black university in the southern United States, is founded in Raleigh, North Carolina
en.s: Shaw University is a private historically Black university in Raleigh, North Carolina. Founded on December 1, 1865, Shaw University is the oldest HBCU to begin offering courses in the Southern United States. The school had its origin in the formation of a theological class of freedmen in the Guion Hotel. The following year it moved to a large wooden building, at the corner of Blount and Cabarrus Streets in Raleigh, where it continued as the Raleigh Institute until 1870.

zh.s: 肖大学是位于北卡罗来纳州罗利市的一所私立黑人历史大学，创立于1865年12月1日，是美国南部最早开设课程的黑人大学。该校最初是在吉恩酒店为获得自由的黑人开设的神学课程。次年，学校迁至罗利布朗特街与卡巴勒斯街交汇处的一栋大型木楼，并以罗利学院的名称办学至1870年。

en.s: The Battle of Villepion was a battle between the French XVI Corps under General Chanzy and the I Bavarian Corps during the Franco-Prussian War. It occurred in the district of Terminiers, between Terminiers and Nonneville on 1 December 1870, and ended in a French victory. After the Battle of Beaune-la-Rolande on 28 November 1870 the Corps in the centre of the French Army of the Loire advanced and made a swing east towards Pithiviers. On the early afternoon of 1 December an infantry division and a cavalry division of the French XVI Corps met I. Bayerischen Korps.

zh.s: 1870年12月1日，普法战争期间，法国尚齐将军指挥的第16军团与巴伐利亚第一军团在埃尔-卢瓦尔省特米尼耶和农维尔之间的地区交战。战斗以法军获胜告终。11月28日博讷拉罗朗德之战后，法国卢瓦尔军团中央部队向东朝皮蒂维耶推进。12月1日下午早些时候，第16军团一个步兵师和一个骑兵师遭遇巴伐利亚第一军团。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Empire of Brazil on 1 December 1884 to elect members of the 19th legislature of the Chamber of Deputies. These were the second direct elections held in the country after the Saraiva Law was enacted (Law No. 3,029 of 9 January 1881). The Liberal Party won 67 seats, the Conservative Party won 55, and the Republican Party won 3.

zh.s: 1884年12月1日，巴西帝国举行议会选举，选出第19届众议院议员。这是1881年1月9日《萨赖瓦法》颁布后，该国举行的第二次直接选举。自由党赢得67席，保守党赢得55席，共和党赢得3席。

en.s: The Sino-Portuguese Treaty of Peking was a treaty signed on 1 December 1887 between the Kingdom of Portugal and the Qing dynasty. Regarded by China as one of the unequal treaties concluded following the Second Opium War, it granted Portugal perpetual colonial rights over Macau in exchange for its cooperation in curbing the smuggling of opium.

en.t: The Buenos Aires Metro, the first underground railway system in the Southern Hemisphere and in Latin America, begins operation
en.s: The Buenos Aires Underground (Spanish: Subterráneo de Buenos Aires), locally known as Subte (Spanish: [ˈsuβte]), is a rapid transit system that serves the area of the city of Buenos Aires, Argentina. The first section of this network (Plaza de Mayo–Plaza Miserere) opened in 1913, making it the 13th earliest subway network in the world and the first underground railway in Latin America, the Southern Hemisphere, and the Spanish-speaking world, with the Madrid Metro opening nearly six years later, in 1919.

zh.t: 布宜诺斯艾利斯地铁开通运营
zh.s: 布宜诺斯艾利斯地铁（西班牙语：Subterráneo de Buenos Aires），当地称Subte，是服务于阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯市区的快速交通系统。首段线路（五月广场站至米塞雷雷广场站）于1913年开通，使其成为世界第13个开通的地铁系统，也是拉丁美洲、南半球和西班牙语世界的首个地下铁路系统。马德里地铁于近六年后的1919年开通。

en.s: The Sheksna uprising (Russian: Пришексни́нское восста́ние, romanized: Prisheksninskoye Vostaniye) was an anti-Bolshevik uprising in townships on the Sheksna River in the Vologda and Cherpovets provinces between 1–3 December 1918. The rebels seized the railway station Sheksna and broke railway communication on the Cherepovets-Vologda line, jeopardizing messages to Petrograd. The uprising was suppressed by Red Army troops arriving from Vologda and Cherpovets.

zh.s: 舍克斯纳起义是1918年12月1日至3日发生在舍克斯纳河沿岸城镇的反布尔什维克起义，地点在沃洛格达省和切列波韦茨省。起义者占领舍克斯纳火车站，切断切列波韦茨至沃洛格达的铁路交通，影响了通往彼得格勒的通信。随后，从沃洛格达和切列波韦茨赶来的红军镇压了起义。

en.s: The Attempted coup of 1924 in Estonia (Estonian: 1. detsembri riigipöördekatse), conducted by the Comintern, was a failed coup attempt in Estonia staged by Communists (mostly infiltrated from Soviet Union) on December 1, 1924. Of the 279 actively participating communists, 125 were killed in action, later more than 500 people were arrested. The government forces lost 26 men. During the Soviet occupation of Estonia from 1940 until the era of Perestroika and Glasnost in the Soviet history of the Estonian SSR the communist coup attempt was referred to as Tallinn Uprising of December 1, 1924 against the Yoke of the National Bourgeoisie Government of Estonia and described as an event in the series of World revolution.

en.s: The Ontario general election, 1926 was the 17th general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. The Ontario Conservative Party, led by George Howard Ferguson, was re-elected for a second term in government, despite losing a few seats in the Legislative Assembly. The principal issue of the campaign was the government's proposal to repeal the Ontario Temperance Act and replace prohibition with government control of liquor sales.

en.t: Establishment of People's Bank of China
en.s: The People's Bank of China (officially PBC and unofficially PBOC) is the central bank of the People's Republic of China. The PBC was established in 1948 as the bank serving areas of mainland China under Chinese Communist Party (CCP) control and became China's sole central bank after the founding of the People's Republic of China in 1949.

en.s: The Battle of Sunchon was an air battle fought near the city of Sunchon, North Korea on 1 December 1951, during the Korean War. Up to 14 Gloster Meteor jets of the RAAF's 77 Squadron were attacked by at least 20 MiG-15s of the Soviet Union's 176th Guards Fighter Aviation Regiment (176 GIAP). The MiGs carried Chinese air force markings, as the USSR was not officially a combatant in the Korean War. Its experience in the battle led to 77 Squadron's being redeployed to ground attack duties. 77 Squadron was engaged in an offensive sweep, at 19,000 feet (5,800 metres) when the action commenced, at about 0900 hours.

zh.s: 1951年12月1日，朝鲜战争期间，朝鲜北部鲜川附近发生空战。澳大利亚皇家空军第77中队最多有14架格洛斯特“流星”喷气式战斗机，遭到至少20架苏联第176近卫歼击航空团的米格-15战机攻击。由于苏联并未正式参战，米格战机涂有中国空军标志。这次战斗的经验促使第77中队改为执行对地攻击任务。交战约于上午9时开始，当时该中队正在19,000英尺（5,800米）高度进行进攻性巡逻。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Toronto, Canada, on December 1, 1952. Incumbent mayor Allan Lamport easily won against former alderman Nathan Phillips. en.s: Operation Bretagne was a French Union military operation between 1 December 1952 and 4 January 1953, during the First Indochina War. Four Mobile Groups (Groupes Mobiles, GM) and General de Berchoux's two Amphibian Sub-Groups hunted and engaged the 9th Regiment (304th Division) and the 48th Regiment (320th Division) of the Viet Minh, who were threatening the bishopric of Bui Chu, in Nam Định province.

en.t: Our Lady of the Angels School fire
en.s: On Monday, December 1, 1958, a fire broke out at Our Lady of the Angels School in Chicago, Illinois, shortly before classes were to be dismissed for the day. The fire originated in the basement of the school near the foot of a stairway. The elementary school was operated by the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Chicago and had an enrollment of approximately 1600 students. A total of 92 pupils and 3 nuns ultimately died when smoke, heat, fire, and toxic gasses cut off their normal means of escape through corridors and stairways.

zh.s: 1958年12月1日星期一，芝加哥天使之后学校在当天课程即将结束前发生火灾，起火点在学校地下室的楼梯底部附近。学校由芝加哥罗马天主教总教区运营，约有1600名学生。浓烟、高温、火焰和有毒气体堵住了走廊和楼梯等正常逃生路线，最终造成92名学生和3名修女死亡。

en.s: The Antarctic Treaty and related agreements, collectively known as the Antarctic Treaty System (ATS), regulate international relations with respect to Antarctica, Earth's only continent without a native human population. It was the first arms control agreement established during the Cold War, designating the continent as a scientific preserve, establishing freedom of scientific investigation, and banning military activity; for the purposes of the treaty system, Antarctica is defined as all the land and ice shelves south of 60°S latitude. Since September 2004, the Antarctic Treaty Secretariat, which implements the treaty system, is headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina. The main treaty was opened for signature on 1 December 1959, and officially entered into force on 23 June 1961.

zh.t: 《南极条约》签署并开启缔约体系
zh.s: 《南极条约》及相关协议合称南极条约体系，用于规范南极地区的国际关系。南极是唯一没有原住民人口的大陆。该条约是冷战期间首个军备控制协议，将南极划为科学保护区，保障科学考察自由，并禁止军事活动。按条约体系的定义，南极包括南纬60度以南的所有陆地和冰架。负责落实该体系的南极条约秘书处自2004年9月起设在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯。核心条约于1959年12月1日开放签署，并于1961年6月23日正式生效。

en.s: General elections were held in Senegal on 1 December 1963. It was the first time the President had been directly elected. en.s: Municipal elections were held in Toronto, Canada, on December 1, 1969. Across Metro Toronto there were few surprising results, and city of Toronto incumbent mayor William Dennison was easily re-elected. The one dramatic exception to this was on Toronto city council, where a number of long-standing members lost to young new arrivals who shared a common vision of opposition to the megaprojects that had transformed Toronto throughout the post-war period. While the reform movement candidate for mayor lost, it gained a strong presence on city council. The 1970s reform faction dominated Toronto politics for the next decade.

en.s: The Croatian Spring (Croatian: Hrvatsko proljeće), or Maspok, was a political conflict that took place from 1967 to 1971 in the Socialist Republic of Croatia, at the time part of the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia. en.s: Constituent Assembly elections were held in Bahrain on 1 December 1972. All candidates ran as independents. A total of 15,385 votes were cast (although not all constituencies were contested), giving a turnout of 88.5%. However, only 12.5% of the population were registered voters at the time. The constituent assembly was charged with drafting and ratifying a constitution, following Bahrain's independence from Britain in 1971. The law drawn up by the government restricted the electorate to male citizens aged twenty years or over. The assembly consisted of twenty-two delegates who were elected by the public, along with eight delegates appointed by the Amir, and the twelve members of the royally-appointed Council of Ministers in their ex-officio capacity.

zh.s: 1972年12月1日，巴林举行制宪会议选举，所有候选人均以无党籍身份参选。共投出15,385张选票，投票率为88.5%，但当时登记选民仅占总人口的12.5%。制宪会议负责起草并批准宪法，此前巴林于1971年脱离英国独立。政府制定的法律将选民限制为年满20岁的男性公民。会议包括民选的22名代表、埃米尔任命的8名代表，以及当然成员身份的12名王室任命内阁成员。

en.t: World AIDS Day is proclaimed worldwide by the UN member states
en.s: World AIDS Day, designated on 1 December every year since 1988, is an international day dedicated to raising awareness of the AIDS pandemic caused by the spread of HIV infection and mourning those who have died of the disease. The acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) is a life-threatening condition caused by the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). The HIV virus attacks the immune system of the patient and reduces its resistance to other diseases.

zh.s: 自1988年起，每年12月1日为世界艾滋病日。这一国际纪念日旨在提高人们对艾滋病疫情的认识，并悼念死于该病的人。艾滋病是由人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）感染引起的危及生命的疾病。HIV会攻击患者的免疫系统，降低其抵抗其他疾病的能力。

en.s: The most serious coup d'etat against the government of Philippine President Corazon Aquino was staged beginning December 1, 1989 by members of the Armed Forces of the Philippines belonging to the Reform the Armed Forces Movement (RAM) and soldiers loyal to former President Ferdinand Marcos. Metro Manila was shaken by this Christmas coup, and they almost seized the presidential palace. It was completely defeated by the Philippine government by December 9, 1989. Zumel, and staged by an alliance of the RAM, led by Honasan, and troops loyal to Marcos, led by Zumel.

en.t: British and French Channel Tunnel crews break through in the service tunnel
en.s: On December 1, 1990, British and French construction crews met beneath the English Channel when their service tunnel broke through. en.s: A presidential election was held in Ukraine on 1 December 1991. They were the first direct presidential elections in the country's history, the first completely free national elections of any sort since 1918, and only the second free elections in the country's history. Leonid Kravchuk, the Chairman of the Verkhovna Rada and de facto acting president, was elected with 61.6% of the vote. An independence referendum took place on the same day, with 91 percent voting to secede from the Soviet Union. All six presidential candidates supported independence and campaigned for a "yes" vote in the referendum.

zh.s: 1991年12月1日，乌克兰举行总统选举。这是乌克兰历史上首次直选总统，也是自1918年以来首次完全自由的全国选举。最高拉达主席、事实上的代理总统列昂尼德·克拉夫丘克以61.6%的得票率当选。同日举行独立公投，91%的选民支持脱离苏联。6名总统候选人均支持独立，并在公投中呼吁投赞成票。

en.s: A referendum on the Act of Declaration of Independence was held in Ukraine on 1 December 1991. An overwhelming majority of 92% of voters approved the declaration of independence made by the Verkhovna Rada on 24 August 1991. The public vote was held in response to the failed August coup and the New Union Treaty not being signed. Voters were asked "Do you confirm the Act of Declaration of Independence of Ukraine?" The text of the Declaration was included as a preamble to the question. The referendum was called by the Parliament of Ukraine to confirm the Act of Independence, which was adopted by the Parliament on 24 August 1991.

zh.s: 1991年12月1日，乌克兰就《独立宣言法案》举行公投。92%的选民以压倒性多数支持最高拉达于1991年8月24日通过的独立宣言。公投是在八月政变失败、新联盟条约未能签署后举行的。选民被问及：“你是否确认乌克兰独立宣言法案？”该法案全文作为问题的序言附上。公投由乌克兰议会发起，以确认8月24日通过的独立法案。

en.t: The law on same-sex marriage comes into force in South Africa, legalizing same-sex marriage for the first time on the African continent
en.s: Same-sex marriage has been legal in South Africa since the Civil Union Act, 2006 came into force on 30 November 2006. The decision of the Constitutional Court in the case of Minister of Home Affairs v Fourie on 1 December 2005 extended the common-law definition of marriage to include same-sex spouses—as the Constitution of South Africa guarantees equal protection before the law to all citizens regardless of sexual orientation—and gave Parliament one year to rectify the inequality in the marriage statutes.

zh.t: 南非同性婚姻法生效，成为非洲大陆首个同性婚姻合法化的国家
zh.s: 自《2006年民事结合法》于2006年11月30日生效以来，同性婚姻在南非一直合法。2005年12月1日，南非宪法法院在“内政部长诉富里案”中将普通法对婚姻的定义扩展至同性配偶。由于南非宪法保障所有公民不因性取向而受到不同的平等保护，法院要求议会在一年内纠正婚姻法规中的不平等。

en.s: The 2009 Welsh Labour leadership election was held following the resignation of Rhodri Morgan, who stepped down after nine years as First Minister of Wales. Morgan had made clear his intent to resign in 2009 as far back as 2005. As Morgan had been elected unopposed in 2000, this was the first contested election for the Welsh Labour leadership for more than a decade. The contest concluded on 1 December 2009 and was won on the first round by Carwyn Jones who won in all three sections of the ballot.

en.t: 2009 Liberal Party of Australia leadership spill
en.s: A leadership spill was held on 1 December 2009 to elect the leader of the Liberal Party of Australia. Tony Abbott was elected, defeating incumbent leader Malcolm Turnbull and Joe Hockey. Abbott thus replaced Turnbull as leader of the Opposition, and would lead the party to the 2010 federal election. The spill was the culmination of a dispute within the Liberal Party over its response to the Rudd government's proposed emissions trading scheme (ETS).

zh.s: 2009年12月1日，澳大利亚自由党举行领袖改选。托尼·阿博特击败时任党领袖马尔科姆·特恩布尔和乔·霍基当选，接替特恩布尔成为反对党领袖，并将带领该党参加2010年联邦大选。这次改选源于自由党内部对陆克文政府拟议的碳排放交易计划意见不一。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Romania on 1 December 2024. No party won a majority in the election, which saw the incumbent National Coalition for Romania (CNR), led by the Social Democratic Party (PSD) and the National Liberal Party (PNL), lose their majority in both chambers of parliament alongside significant gains by far-right parties such as the Alliance for the Union of Romanians (AUR), S.O.S.

zh.s: 2024年12月1日，罗马尼亚举行议会选举。没有政党赢得多数席位，执政的罗马尼亚全国联盟在参众两院均失去多数席位，极右翼政党则取得明显进展。英文摘要随后在政党名单处截断，未补写缺失信息。

en.s: DEFY x Progress Onslaught was a two-night professional wrestling event co-promoted by Progress Wrestling and DEFY Wrestling. It took place on November 29 and December 1, 2024, at the Roulette Intermedium (in Brooklyn) and at Thalia Hall (in Chicago). Both nights of the event were streamed live on Triller TV. The card comprised a total of 15 matches, with eight on the first night and seven on the second.

zh.s: 《Onslaught》是一场由Progress Wrestling和DEFY Wrestling共同举办的两晚职业摔角赛事。两场比赛分别于2024年11月29日在布鲁克林的Roulette Intermedium，以及12月1日在芝加哥的Thalia Hall举行，并通过Triller TV直播。赛事共安排15场比赛，首晚8场，次晚7场。
